Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1034
Claimant:
Paul Oconnor
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-11-12
The insured reported a hit-while-turning-left collision at an intersectoin and the claimant's vehicle was struck on its
driver side. The claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
2024-01-09
The police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact, and the
other driver's account matches the insured's description of the turn. Photos taken at the scene are consistent with the
reported sequence.
2024-02-07
Initial damage appraisal shows the impact damage is largely in line with the described collision. No prior damage to
the vehicle has come to light in our records or in the photos reviewed.
2024-02-22
The claimant reported a wrist fracture from the collision, which is a plausible injury for a force of this kind. The
attorney submitted the initial medical summary and asked that the claim be handled on the bodily injury track.
2024-03-08
The claimant gave the same account of the collision in the recorded statement and again in a follow-up call with the
attorney present. Details of the sequence did not shift between conversations.
2024-03-09
The driver is listed on the policy and the coverage was in force on the date of loss. Notihng in the underwriting file
suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage period.
2024-03-11
Records show no earlier injury to the wrist or nearby body areas, based on the prior medical history the attorney
provided and our database search.
2024-03-28
Treatment has increased sharply, with visits now happening almost every day and several times the typical volume
for a wrist fracture of this type. New body areas were added to the treatment plan several weeks after the crash.
2024-04-10
The treating provider's notes list additional complaints in areas not mentioned in the first report. We have requested
the complete records and an independent medical review to assess how these relate to the collision.
2024-04-17
The adjuster discussed the escalating treatment pattern with the attorney, who said the claimant's care is following
the physician's recommendations. We are awaiting the independent review before setting a reserve.
2024-05-23
Current status is open pending the medical review. The liability picture remains clear, with the other driver accepting
responsibility for the turning-left collision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
